## Checklist

Tick each item, or say why it does not apply. `CONTRIBUTING.md` explains each one.

- [ ] `pnpm type-check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:quickjs`, and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] A sandbox-behaviour change bumps `ENGINE_REV` in `engine/protocol.ts`.
- [ ] A fix has a row in `docs/history/improvements.md`.
- [ ] A user-visible change updates `docs/user-guide.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A confirmed host limit is filed in `docs/limitations.md` with its evidence.
- [ ] New engine logic lives in `engine/` and is driven by snapshots, not live proxies.
